method: Synthetic DOM events (mousemove, mousedown, mouseup, click, touchstart, touchend) dispatched on the canvas of the PUBLISHED page; page state read back from its own variables (sel, hi, cam, route, panel display). The browser pane was hidden (document.visibilityState='hidden'), so requestAnimationFrame does not fire: this verifies handler LOGIC only. Appearance, animation and real pointer input are NOT verified. The zoomed camera was emulated by scaling cam directly because flyTo is rAF-driven.
